message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/sleuthkit && ls; echo "==="; cat tsk/fs/apfs_fs.cpp | head -250` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
No git history. Let me understand the vulnerability better. The crash is an "unknown read in `std::__1::enable_if<true, memory_view>::type`". This is the `memory_view::as<T>()` function. The `as<T>()` does `reinterpret_cast<T*>(_storage)` without checking that `count() >= sizeof(T)`. So if the value/key data is too short, reading `*ptr` will read out of bounds.

Let me look at how the APFS filesystem is opened and what input file format is expected. Let me look at the test harness / how the target is invoked.
